title: Fix schema skew during VPC operator upgrade blocker
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Several on-prem / VPC customers observed Helm chart upgrades for the control-plane stack fail during the CRD and operator upgrade step. The operator enters a crashloop or refuses to reconcile existing CustomResources because an upstream OpenAPI/CRD schema change introduced a required field and stricter validation. That validation mismatch combined with leader-election timestamp skew caused the Helm post-upgrade hook to time out and left clusters in a mixed state.

Why this is urgent: Customers with Dedicated/Private deployments are blocked from completing a security/bugfix release that depends on the runtime image update. Multiple support escalations were opened; at least two customers rolled back and requested a supported hotfix path.

Scope: Affects on-prem and VPC private-control-plane upgrades where customers have CRs created before 2026-02-15 and use Helm v3.9+ with default --validation behavior. Not observed on hosted (SaaS) where we control the upgrade ordering.

Observed behavior: During helm upgrade, the operator's webhook rejects manifests because the new CRD validation marks fields as required and disallows unknown object shapes. Existing CRs lacking the new field are rejected; the operator either crashes or marks resources NotFound/Forbidden in its reconciliation loop. Helm hook times out at the "post-upgrade-reconcile" stage, leaving other components upgraded but control-plane partially degraded.
steps_to_reproduce: Prepare a private cluster with control-plane runtime-1.23 and operator v2.8
Install sample CRs created before 2026-02-15 (omit new optional fields)
Run helm upgrade to chart runtime-1.24 that includes updated CRD validation and operator v2.9
Observe the operator logs: schema validation errors citing missing fields or disallowed additionalProperties
Helm post-upgrade hook waits for operator reconciliation and then times out leaving release in FAILED/DEGRADED state
root_cause_analysis: CRD change in chart v1.24 introduced a stricter OpenAPI schema that marked newly-referenced fields with 'required' and removed 'x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields'.
Operator v2.9 added server-side validation checks earlier in reconciliation path; previously we tolerated missing fields in controller logic.
Helm upgrade ordering performs CRD apply before preflight migration; when CRs don't conform, the admission webhook blocks reconciliation.
Leader-election skew (clock drift on customer nodes) caused more frequent controller restarts revealing a race between CRD registration and webhook availability.
Lack of an automated preflight migration to patch historic CRs is the main gap in our private upgrade path.
mitigation_and_workarounds: Customer-facing short-term: instruct affected customers to run the provided pre-upgrade patch script to add the new fields with safe defaults and re-run helm upgrade (script link in attachments).
If customers cannot run scripts, recommend a controlled rollback to prior chart and open a support case for assisted patching.
Cluster operators can temporarily set helm upgrade to skip hooks and perform component-by-component upgrades while we ship a hotfix (documented in runbook).
proposed_fix: Ship runtime-1.24-hotfix1 chart that: (a) relaxes CRD validation to be backward-compatible (reintroduce preserve-unknown-fields or remove 'required' for the new fields used for telemetry), and (b) registers a short-lived admission webhook shim that accepts older CR shapes.
Add a pre-upgrade migration Job (k8s Job template in chart) that patches existing CRs to include safe defaults for the new fields before the CRD validation is applied.
Update operator v2.9 to include a guarded reconciliation path that tolerates missing fields for 72 hours post-upgrade and emits telemetry to our dashboard for customers who opt-in.
Create an automated verification script that runs as part of our upgrade pipeline for Private (runs CR scans and reports a list of non-conforming CRs).
acceptance_criteria: Hotfix chart (runtime-1.24-hotfix1) published to helm repository and smoke-tested in internal staging clusters
Preflight migration job added to the chart and tested on historically-created CRs with/without the new fields
Operator binary built with tolerant reconciliation and deployed in a canary pool with successful reconciliation of legacy CR shapes
Support runbook and a scripted customer patch path published and communicated to affected accounts
No additional customer escalations for the same failure mode for 14 days after rollout
rollout_plan: Day 0 (now): Communicate status to escalated customers with mitigation steps and expected ETA for hotfix (PM: Marcos Rivera)
Day 1: Merge PR for chart hotfix and preflight job -> internal CI smoke tests -> tag runtime-1.24-hotfix1
Day 2: Deploy hotfix to staging and a small set of Managed Private customers (opt-in) for canary verification
Day 3: Open controlled rollout to remaining affected Private/VPC customers with manual approval from Solutions Eng
Fallback: If any canary shows persistent failures, publish explicit rollback instructions and engage SRE on-call for assisted remediation
comments: 2026-03-08 - Aisha Patel: Triage completed; assigned to Liam. Preliminary logs attached. Observed admission errors pointing to new field 'nodeAgentConfig'.
2026-03-09 - Liam Chen: Reproduced in local minikube with historical CRs. Confirmed helm hook timeout aligns with CRD apply order. Preparing candidate chart change to relax CRD validation.
2026-03-10 - Marcos Rivera (PM): Notifying top-5 affected customers and coordinating Solutions Eng for assisted remediation windows. Labeling P0 for visibility.
2026-03-11 - Design review by Noor Khan: API change OK if we mark fields as optional and include deprecation note in release notes. Please include acceptance tests.
2026-03-12 - Liam Chen: Opened PR for hotfix chart and preflight job. CI failing in one case due to leader-election retries; adding liveness probe adjustments.
2026-03-13 - Aisha Patel: Preparing message template for customer comms and updating incident dashboard. Planning a 09:00 PST deploy window for canary customers.
postmortem_actions: Add automated CR compatibility check to pre-release CI for all chart bumps that modify CRD validation
Document and ship a standard pre-upgrade migration Job pattern for Private deployments
Improve upgrade runbook to include clock skew checks and leader-election detection heuristics
Add an internal alert that fires when Helm post-upgrade hooks exceed 10m with operator-related errors
Schedule a retrospective with Support, SRE, and Product to review escalation handling and SLAs
